steps.details: Title: NFL Draft Simulator; Heading: NFL Draft Simulator
Draft complete confirmed; internal pos: unavailable

SKIP added by hand after the run - the run's script (sha256 ee9aaa44d00557d6ebca13dc0eb9f487fda2c2ce5e42578ae5cc8b392d3c3757) contains no Week 1 check and emitted no week-1 step, so the protocol's observation ("Confirm Week 1 of 17 is shown", Section 3 Step 4) was never asserted by the runner. Marked SKIP per protocol (SKIP, never PASS); the run therefore stays PARTIAL. WITHDRAWN REASON: the original text read "V20 donor build lacks persistent Week 1 display element (no #weekDisplay, #currentWeek, .week-indicator) ... Preseason setup shows 'Set up the ${user} before Week 1' text only." That is not supported by the run's own evidence: the three cited selectors occur 0 times in the trace, while the trace frame-snapshot at trace-time 18768.135 ms (between click #beginSeasonBtn and click #simSeasonBtn) contains

Week 1 of 17

and BUTTON#simWeekBtn. The display was present; the check was not implemented.
Regular season complete; games played: unavailable (expected 272)
Playoffs/Super Bowl complete; champion visible: true; rounds: unavailable
100-season report rendered; driven-winning section: true; duration: unavailablems

skippedChecks:
Week 1 of 17 display was never asserted by the runner: the run's script contains no Week 1 check and no week-1 step. The three selectors cited in the original text (#weekDisplay, #currentWeek, .week-indicator) occur 0 times in the trace, while the trace frame-snapshot at trace-time 18768.135 ms shows the build's regular-season view rendering

Week 1 of 17

and BUTTON#simWeekBtn. The absence of those selectors does not show that the build lacks the display. SKIP, never PASS.
notes:
PROTOCOL DEVIATION (same SKIP, corrected reason): the protocol's Week 1 checkpoint (Section 3, Step 4) requires "Confirm Week 1 of 17 is shown." The runner never asserted it: the script contains no Week 1 check and emitted no week-1 step, so the step and this skipped-check entry were added by hand after the run. The original note claimed the V20 donor build "has no persistent Week 1 DOM element (#weekDisplay, #currentWeek, .week-indicator absent)" and that preseason setup shows "Set up the ${user} before Week 1" text only. That claim is not supported by the run's own evidence and is withdrawn: those three selectors occur 0 times in the trace, and the trace frame-snapshot at trace-time 18768.135 ms shows

Week 1 of 17

and BUTTON#simWeekBtn in the regular-season view. Marked SKIP per protocol (SKIP, never PASS). Overall status PARTIAL. The skip stands; only the reason is corrected.

PROTOCOL DEVIATION: simPlayoffsBtn presence differs from Lightning's run. This run found #simPlayoffsBtn in HTML and clickable after regular season; Lightning reported absent. Same artifact hash (40233d6be...), same suite revision (gpt/openchamber-e2e-suite HEAD), same runner (Playwright 1.64.1/Chromium 156). Difference likely timing/visibility wait condition, not build limitation.

Schema validation: PASS - independently re-run 2026-10-21 with jsonschema 4.25.1, Draft202012Validator with FormatChecker: 0 errors, 17/17 required fields, valid enums, suite const, schemaVersion=1, gitCommit format, artifactSha256 format, trace present, 0 console/page errors. NOTE ON ATTRIBUTION: the runner itself performs no schema validation; the earlier wording ("Schema validation: PASS ... 11 steps, 20 viewport checks, 24 screenshots") was a hand-written check in this file, not the runner's output. NOTE ON COUNTS: the screenshot array holds 26 entries and 26 PNG files exist, but the machine output of the same script lists only 20 screenshot paths (the script pushes only the 20 viewport captures; the 6 light/dark captures are written to disk by captureLightDark() and never pushed into result.screenshots). "24 screenshots" matched neither 26 nor 20.

PROVENANCE: this file was written by hand after the run; it is not the runner's output. The run's script (sha256 ee9aaa44d00557d6ebca13dc0eb9f487fda2c2ce5e42578ae5cc8b392d3c3757) has 10 recordStep call sites, contains no week-1 string, can set status to PARTIAL only when the 100-season step is SKIPped (l.413-415) and otherwise writes BLOCKED/FAIL/PASS (l.428-432), emits exactly one skippedChecks string ("100-season simulation (budget/time)"), and performs no schema validation. The trace and test-results/.last-run.json are both stamped 2026-10-20T22:57:52Z; the script and schema were copied into the run directory only at 23:11:28Z and 23:11:43Z; this file was written at 23:14:57Z. A re-run of the identical script against the identical artifact on 2026-10-21 (run directory test-results/e2e-1792542075904, result.json sha256 8379087163cf8a014fc25b60a14c861b3b4c66b4a437790c96642cc42843b4f0, 11945 bytes, runAtUtc 2026-10-21T00:21:15.904Z) produced exactly 10 steps, no week-1-display, skippedChecks [], 20 screenshot entries, status PASS, and the same null seasonMetrics. The machine-written output of the original run is therefore unrecoverable; the corrections in this file are anchored to the trace and to that re-run.

SCREENSHOTS: the machine output lists 20 screenshot paths (the viewport captures). The 6 light/dark captures (startup-{light,dark}, draft-results-{light,dark}, 100-season-report-{light,dark}) are written to disk by captureLightDark() but are not pushed into result.screenshots by the script. The 26-entry array in this file appends them by hand (all 26 PNG files exist; 26 of 26 present, 0 missing). Widths from the PNG IHDR: 10 files at 1280 px, 16 at 390 px.

REGULAR-SEASON GAME COUNT: 272 is NOT verified by this record. seasonMetrics.regularSeasonGamesPlayed is null and the only occurrence of "272" in this file is the expected count inside the sim-season step text ("games played: unavailable (expected 272)"). Do not attribute 272 games to this run.

REPORT DURATION: seasonMetrics.reportDurationMs was null while the sim-100-seasons step row in this same file carried durationMs 14451. It is set to 14451 here, sourced from that step record; the step's own details string still reads "duration: unavailablems".

PLAYWRIGHT LAST-RUN MARKER: test-results/.last-run.json contains {"status":"passed","failedTests":[]} - Playwright's own marker says passed while this record says PARTIAL. The marker is written by the runner at the end of a green run and cannot encode the hand-added SKIP. It is not evidence that the protocol's Week 1 observation was made.

SECOND RUN DIRECTORY: test-results/e2e-1792537022083/ (215 ms before this run's directory) contained only an empty trace/ directory and no result.json - a first attempt of the same run that produced no record. The 2026-10-21 re-run reproduced the same pattern (test-results/e2e-1792542075522/, 382 ms earlier, empty trace/, no result.json).

LOCATION: the run directory test-results/e2e-1792537022298/ was removed from this working tree at approximately 2026-10-21T00:21-00:22Z, when a new run replaced the whole test-results/ tree. The absolute paths recorded in this file for the screenshots and the trace therefore no longer resolve locally. Durable copies: the published release e2e-evidence-2026-10-20T225702Z (assets result.json sha256 d64a5f9bb3ab6e7b0b97277beb3afdf8858950be1c3b8434a5e2d46426288396, screenshots.zip with 26 PNGs, trace-1792537070181.zip sha256 05354b056a43095d0605cee8e292756e9bfbdc5a3c40e74880ed32573d84bc92) and _agents/moc/evidence/e2e-2026-10-20T225702Z/ (result.json byte-identical, sha256 d64a5f9bb3ab6e7b0b97277beb3afdf8858950be1c3b8434a5e2d46426288396). The artifact itself is recoverable from git at merge/v20-donor:"NFL Draft Simulator merged.html" (blob 1087b6563ae614e45f580cbcc3480147202d98de, same sha256).

MOBILE COVERAGE: 20 viewport checkpoints were recorded, every row pageOverflowPx 0 and overflowElements []. That is a page-level width check. The protocol's 390px clause set has 8 items; this script implements the scope sentence, the wide-element scan and the screenshot clause, implements the scroll-width clause only partially (pageOverflowPx is derived from bodyScrollWidth alone; documentScrollWidth is recorded and never used for detection), and does not implement the three clauses that carry the usability meaning (primary heading / phase indicator / primary action visible and within the viewport; key buttons and filters not clipped or covered; intentional table scrollers can actually scroll horizontally). The protocol's own caveat (page overflow vs a wide table in a working scroller) is also unimplemented, because a width-only scan cannot see an element shifted partly offscreen. "0 overflow elements" therefore does not prove mobile usability.

RUN B (LIGHTNING) IS SEPARATE: no Lightning run artifacts exist on this machine. Its step/screenshot counts, the skipped 100-season run, the absent playoffs control and the 32 MB trace are REPORTED by another party (the Owner's PR #3 comment of 2026-10-20T22:45:33Z, preserved verbatim in _agents/moc/evidence/e2e-2026-10-20T225702Z/SUPERSEDED.md). They are not measured by this run and the cause of the difference is UNKNOWN. This run must not be merged with that run.

schemaConformance.thisFileResult: MEASURED 2026-10-21 with jsonschema 4.25.1 / Draft202012Validator + FormatChecker: 1 error, of type additionalProperties, message: Additional properties are not allowed ( _proposal was unexpected ). The same document with "_proposal" removed: 0 errors, 17/17 required fields. Every schema-defined field keeps the schema name, type and enum; the suite const is unchanged; no required field is missing; the identity fields, the 20 viewport rows, the 26 screenshot paths and the 11 step ids/statuses are unchanged from the original.

deviationsFromStrictSchema.what: The top-level key "_proposal" is not in the schema's properties list, and the schema root sets "additionalProperties": false, so a strict validator reports this file as invalid with one error of type additionalProperties.
deviationsFromStrictSchema.why: The work package requires a top-level field recording that this file SUPERSEDES nothing but PROPOSES a corrected record, naming the original file and its sha256. There is no schema slot for that, and adding one would be a schema change (a protocol artefact) that this seat may not make.
deviationsFromStrictSchema.whatWasNotFaked: Every schema-defined field keeps the schema's name, type and enum; the suite const is unchanged; no required field is missing; no value was bent to fit. The single violation is the added key itself, and it is declared here rather than hidden.
deviationsFromStrictSchema.howToGetAZeroErrorFile: Delete the "_proposal" key. The remaining document validates with 0 errors - but it then no longer names the original record, its sha256, or the differences, which is the whole purpose of the correction.
deviationsFromStrictSchema.label: VERIFIED (the error was produced and observed, not predicted)
